events.verdict: DeRozan (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Bane's (MEM) drive to the basket.
Bane (MEM) moves his pivot foot in the lane.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on LaRavia (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. DeRozan (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Memphis retains possession.
As Sabonis (SAC) returns to the floor reaching for the rebound, he lands on Smart (MEM) and dislodges him from his postion.
Murray (SAC) sets the screen on LaRavia (MEM) and avoids making illegal contact.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) legally contests Fox's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Aldama (MEM) sets the screen on Murray (SAC) and the contact is marginal as the two players come together.
Fox (SAC) contests Smart's (MEM) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Sabonis (SAC) both go to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is incidental. A held ball is whistled when both players have their hands on the ball.
Sabonis (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Jackson Jr. (SAC).
Jackson Jr. (MEM) brings his hand underneath the ball and to a pause before continuing his dribble.
Bane (MEM) and Aldama (MEM) both legally contest Monk's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Monk's (SAC) shot attempt lands out of bounds and the Grizzlies are given possession of the ball.
DeRozan (SAC) commits a take foul on Smart (MEM).
